title: The 13 Best Toasters of 2026
metaDescription: Our 13 picks for toasters of 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at toasters of 2026 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Breville BTA840XL Die-Cast 4-Slice Smart Toaster
products.blurb: Key specs: Thermostatic (Element IQ) shade control, not timer-based, Four 1.5-inch wide slots, Lift-and-look mid-cycle inspection.
strengths: Thermostatic shade control, same shade setting produces consistent results on a cold and warm toaster
Lift-and-look feature, check toast without canceling the cycle
1.5-inch wide slots accommodate thick artisan bread, large bagels, and English muffins
Even browning top-to-bottom across the full slot height
Die-cast housing, substantial build quality, stays cool to the touch
limitations: Heavier than most toasters (5.5 lb), moving it to clean under is slightly more effort
Die-cast finish shows fingerprints and requires regular wiping to maintain appearance
The lift-and-look mechanism adds complexity, more parts in the carriage to wear
features: Thermostatic (Element IQ) shade control, not timer-based
Independent shade dials for left and right slot pairs
Dedicated bagel, frozen, and reheat functions

products.name: Cuisinart CPT-435C Countdown 4-Slice Stainless Steel Toaster
products.blurb: Key specs: LCD countdown display showing seconds remaining, Four 1.5-inch wide slots, 6-shade browning control.
strengths: LCD countdown display shows exact seconds remaining in each cycle
1.5-inch wide slots, same as the Breville BTA840XL, accommodates thick artisan bread and large bagels
6-shade positions for precise browning control
Bagel, frozen, reheat, and cancel modes
3-year Cuisinart warranty
limitations: Timer-based control (not thermostatic), first cycle on a cold toaster may run slightly lighter
LCD display requires a battery, one more component that can eventually fail
Brushed stainless finish shows smudges on the vertical surfaces
Countdown display is on the front face, not visible from across the counter
features: LCD countdown display showing seconds remaining
Bagel, frozen, reheat, and cancel modes

products.name: Breville BTA720XL Die-Cast 2-Slice Smart Toaster
products.blurb: Key specs: Thermostatic (Element IQ) shade control, 1.5-inch wide slots, Lift-and-look mid-cycle inspection.
strengths: Same thermostatic browning consistency as the 4-slice BTA840XL, in a smaller footprint
1.5-inch slots are the widest of any 2-slice toaster on the market, handling bagels without compression
Lift-and-look avoids resetting the cycle when checking progress
Die-cast housing feels noticeably more solid than stamped-metal budget models
limitations: The most expensive 2-slice toaster in this roundup by a wide margin
1-year warranty is shorter than Cuisinart's 3-year coverage on comparable models
Die-cast finish shows fingerprints and needs regular wiping
features: 6-shade settings plus bagel and frozen modes

products.name: Hamilton Beach 24910 4-Slice Toaster
products.blurb: Key specs: 4-slice capacity, 1.2-inch slots, Toast boost lever.
strengths: Toast boost lever raises short slices for easy removal without touching the hot housing
Simple mechanical dial that's easy to use and unlikely to need recalibration
Wide enough slots (1.2 inches) for most sandwich bread and standard bagels
limitations: Browning is noticeably less even at the slot edges than the West Bend or Cuisinart options
1-year warranty, shorter than the Cuisinart CPT-122's 3-year coverage
Housing is stamped metal and plastic, feels less substantial than die-cast competitors

products.name: Black+Decker T2707S 2-Slice Toaster
products.blurb: Key specs: Extra-wide 1.5-inch slots, Toast boost lever, 6-shade browning dial.
strengths: Toast boost lever raises short slices high enough to grab without tongs
Simple mechanical dial is easy to use and rarely needs recalibrating
limitations: Shade consistency varies more between a cold and warm toaster than on timer-compensated models
Housing is stamped metal and plastic, not die-cast, lighter and less rigid than premium models
Crumb tray is small and needs frequent emptying with regular use

products.name: KitchenAid KMT4116CU 4-Slice Long Slot Toaster
products.blurb: Key specs: 12-inch long slots across all 4 slices, 1.3-inch slot width, 5 toast settings plus bagel, reheat, and defrost.
strengths: The only 4-slice toaster in this roundup with true 12-inch long slots, fitting baguette and sandwich-loaf slices
Die-cast housing feels substantially more solid than stamped-metal competitors
Color options let it match a KitchenAid stand mixer or other small appliances
1.3-inch width comfortably handles bagels and thick artisan bread across all four slots
limitations: Priced closer to the Breville than to mid-range Cuisinart options, a premium mainly for slot length
Smaller review base (2,600) than the mainstream Breville and Cuisinart 4-slice models
No thermostatic control, timer-based cycle runs slightly lighter on the first cold slice
features: 5 toast settings plus bagel, reheat, and defrost
Available in matching KitchenAid stand mixer colors

products.name: Oster 2-Slice Toaster with Extra Wide Slots
products.blurb: Key specs: Extra-wide 1.5-inch slots, Stainless steel exterior, 6-shade settings.
strengths: 1.5-inch slots at a budget price, wide enough for bagels and thick bread without forcing
Stainless exterior looks and wipes cleaner than the plastic-bodied competitors at this price
Extra-lift lever raises short slices high enough to remove without touching the hot housing
limitations: Shade dial has visible gaps between settings, fine adjustment isn't really possible
No lift-and-look; checking toast mid-cycle means canceling and restarting
Exterior runs hotter to the touch than die-cast models during back-to-back cycles

products.name: Cuisinart CPT-180P1 Metal Classic 4-Slice Toaster
products.blurb: Key specs: Chrome-and-metal classic body styling, 1.2-inch wide slots, Illuminated shade dial with 6 settings.
strengths: All-metal classic housing looks and feels more premium than the plastic-bodied budget competitors
1.2-inch slots comfortably handle standard bagels and sandwich bread
Illuminated dial makes the current shade setting easy to read at a glance
limitations: Metal exterior conducts heat more than plastic housings, warmer to the touch after several cycles
No thermostatic control, first cold cycle runs slightly lighter than later ones
Heavier than most 4-slice competitors, harder to reposition for cleaning

products.name: Smeg TSF01 2-Slice Toaster
products.blurb: Key specs: Available in 16 exterior colors, 1.4-inch wide slots, 9 shade settings.
strengths: The most visually distinctive toaster in this category, with 16 color options to match kitchen decor
9-position shade dial gives finer browning control than the typical 6-setting toaster
Auto-centering guides keep uneven or oddly shaped slices positioned against the elements
Build quality feels premium, solid door latch, weighted base, minimal wobble
limitations: Priced at a premium mainly for the design; browning performance is good but not class-leading
1.4-inch slots are slightly narrower than the Breville's 1.5-inch, so the largest bagels compress a bit
Limited color availability at any given time, popular colors go out of stock

products.name: West Bend 4-Slice Extra-Wide Toaster
products.blurb: Key specs: Extra-wide 1.5-inch slots, 4-slice capacity, 6-shade settings.
strengths: 4-slice capacity toasts a full breakfast in one cycle for a family of two to four
Consistent browning edge-to-edge for a toaster in this price bracket
limitations: Timer-based control, not thermostatic, first cold cycle runs slightly lighter
1-year warranty, shorter than Cuisinart's 3-year coverage at a similar price
Plastic housing runs warm to the touch during back-to-back cycles

products.name: Dash Clear View Toaster
products.blurb: Key specs: Clear side windows to watch toast browning, 1.1-inch slots, 6-shade settings.
strengths: Clear windows let you watch browning progress without lifting the lever
Compact 7-inch footprint is one of the smallest toasters in this roundup
Simple to clean, no crevices around the viewing windows to trap crumbs
limitations: 1.1-inch slots are narrow, thick artisan bread and large bagels compress noticeably
Plastic housing feels less substantial than metal-bodied competitors
Viewing windows fog slightly with steam on longer cycles, reducing visibility
features: Clear side windows to watch toast browning

products.name: Cuisinart CPT-122 2-Slice Compact Toaster
products.blurb: Key specs: Compact footprint under 8 inches wide, 6-setting shade dial, Slide-out crumb tray.
strengths: Cuisinart's shading consistency at a fraction of the price of premium models
Compact 8-inch footprint fits tight counters and small apartments
Slide-out crumb tray empties without disassembling the toaster
3-year warranty, standard across the Cuisinart lineup
limitations: Slots are around 1.1 inches wide, squeezes thick artisan bread
No lift-and-look; canceling mid-cycle to check toast resets the cycle
Plastic housing runs warmer to the touch than metal-bodied models

products.name: KitchenAid KMT2115 2-Slice Toaster
strengths: Extra-wide slots fit bagels and thick bread
Manual high-lift lever for small items
Removable crumb tray
Several color finishes
limitations: Only 5 shade settings
No bagel or defrost presets on some versions
Exterior gets warm

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
